world_frame.setting: A Hogwarts containment drill that escalates from the boot room to the clock tower during a magical pest outbreak.
world_frame.player_role: groundskeeper-magizoology trainee using enchanted tongs to clear pests from a warded footprint
world_frame.pressure_source: escaped pixies and cursed beetles destabilizing a containment sigil
world_frame.reward_fantasy: restoring the ward and tidying a magical crisis through fast creature captures
world_frame.failure_fantasy: the ward collapses and the castle drill spirals out of control

mapping_rules: neon cyan or arcade blue -> antique spell gold or ward violet
hot pink arcade accents -> plum spell glow or crimson danger
flat black UI -> deep midnight parchment-backed panel tones
bright success green -> ward emerald with gold highlights

typography.tone: ceremonial for headings, clean and readable for active play UI

shape_language.corner_logic: panels stay rounded and touch-safe, but internal decoration uses pointed gothic arches and diamond highlights
shape_language.stroke_feel: thin magical brass borders with soft glow edges
shape_language.shadow_glow_feel: soft candle glow plus restrained violet magic bloom

ui_system.hud_style: brass-framed ward gauge on a midnight panel with parchment/gold labels
ui_system.button_treatment: spell-plum gradient buttons with embossed gold edge and strong pressed depth
ui_system.card_treatment: vellum-like magical panels with subtle glints and no hard mechanical changes
ui_system.copy_tone: clear, urgent, and magical; use containment, ward, capture, sigil, drill

rules: background motion must remain secondary to draggable entity readability
effects should pulse or drift, never cross the main touch area aggressively
danger flashes may intensify at low health without hiding bugs

five_level_progression.name: Boot Room Induction
five_level_progression.background_note: cozy Hogwarts prep room with trunks, scarves, and candle motes

five_level_progression.name: Moving Stair Mischief
five_level_progression.background_note: portrait corridor with slow shifting stair silhouettes

five_level_progression.name: Greenhouse Overflow
five_level_progression.background_note: glasshouse panes, spores, vines, and rooted sigil glow

five_level_progression.name: Forbidden Forest Edge
five_level_progression.background_note: moon haze, web filaments, and forest-line ward runes

five_level_progression.name: Battle of the Clock Tower
five_level_progression.background_note: lightning, banners, and shield-rune ripples over the battlements

safe_implementation_notes: Preserve drag-clear interaction, score math, health drain, and fail semantics exactly.
Theme the world through HUD labels, menu copy, panel styling, reaction cards, and atmospheric overlays.
Do not add new abilities, spell buttons, inventory, or combat language that suggests unsupported mechanics.
Prefer CSS and DOM dressing now; reserve any deeper canvas art swaps for later visual stages.
